title: Chapter 386 Class
content:
Chapter 386 Class

Although Hecheng County is small, it is still barely acceptable as an initial startup site.

The power of the entire Hecheng is very weak, at least compared to Zhong Yu.

There are only 5,000 and 2 ranks, of which there are no more than 500 ranks of rank 3, less than 10 ranks of rank 4, and only one strong man of rank 5. It was this person who happened to travel here and couldn't bear the loss of life, so he stayed to help the county resisted.

How can such a weak force be placed in Zhong Yu's eyes?

Not to mention anything else, just say that with Zhong Yu's current strength, one person can destroy this county without any injuries, just consume some mana.

Not to mention that Zhong Yu didn't come alone this time, he was out of luck and encountered a rather rare chaotic torrent.

Seriously injured, he had no choice but to come to Japan, which is extremely far away, and lost contact with the small world, so it was difficult to get any support from it.

That's why I had to start from scratch and farm slowly.

But now this world has already been selected, and luck is quite good, there is no accident, and I came here directly.

With Zhong Yu, the master of the small world, as a fixed point, if you want to draw power from the small world to help him develop, you don't have to be like Zhong Yu at the beginning.

Across countless universes and voids, passing through many worlds, it took countless time to get here.

There is a node in the small world, especially the node inside the Liao Zhai world, which is equivalent to someone opening the door on its own initiative, and can directly send people over through the space tunnel, which is very convenient.

There is no need to cross between universes, not to mention wasting power, and there is danger.

So that is to say, as long as Zhong Yu does not leave this world, he can directly draw power from the small world, and transfer the army under his command to help him.

You can directly omit the accumulation time of initial farming and start the great cause of conquest.

Now his small world is not as shabby as before.

After conquering the world of Qin Shimingyue, while going to conquer the Japanese world, Zhong Yu also dispatched dozens of other troops to conquer some worlds with smaller power levels.

When Zhong Yu returned from the Japanese world, the conquest of these sent troops was almost completed.

After all, what he picked were only some ordinary worlds with internal strength, but the strength would not exceed the fourth level, and there was no existence of the fifth level.

With the support of Zhong Yu, coupled with the background of the entire Qin Shi Mingyue World, it is natural that there will be no disadvantages for the high-level against the low-level.

After a trip, Zhong Yuchu only dispatched 57 teams, and they brought a large number of other troops left in Qin Shimingyue, which is tasteless compared to Zhong Yu.

But they all have some internal strength, but they can't meet Zhong Yu's strict fourth-order standard.

In Zhong Yu's eyes, these troops belonged to cannon fodder, but in other lower-level worlds, they belonged to first-class masters, god-like figures.

Putting it anywhere is a master-level powerhouse who can establish a sect.

When the powerful immortal figures in their eyes have an establishment and attack them on a large scale, how can they resist.

So their fall was inevitable, the whole process was quite smooth, even if there were twists and turns, it was just a little extra effort.

However, not everything went smoothly, there were still setbacks in a few worlds, not only did not conquer, even the manpower they sent stumbled and died completely.

But compared to the whole, the future is still bright, the strategy is still successful, and the harvest is still very rich.

The 57 teams had 51 successes, from which they harvested an unknown amount of luck and gained an unknown amount of strength, which greatly enriched Zhong Yu's army.

For the first time, Zhong Yu's Tier 4 legion reached tens of thousands, and the 10,000 blood soldiers he refined finally had a master.

It can be said that the 10,000 legion under Zhong Yu's command is a first-class elite even in this incredibly powerful world.

Judging from the news obtained during these days and the actions of the Demon King of Huangshan, we can still deduce some of the power system in this world.

First of all, the strength of the first level can be said to be achieved by ordinary people in this world, which is nothing.

Only after reaching the second level can one be considered a regular soldier and belong to a country's regular combat power.

Similarly, the second-level conversion to other sects and the like belong to the lowest level of disciples, which is the foundation of a sect.

The strength of Tier 3 is more prominent than that of Tier 2, but there is no essential change.

Among the armies of various countries, he has been able to serve as a small captain of ten people. Among the major sects, he can be regarded as an elite disciple, he can be regarded as the main force of a sect, and he has a little status.

At the fourth level, there has been an earth-shaking change in strength. According to the difference in their cultivation, the corresponding changes are also different, but overall their strength is not much different.

Tier 4 has been able to serve as a hundred-man general in the armies of various countries. The local army that is close to it can even serve as a general of 200 or even 500 people.

Among the major sects, it would be a talented true disciple, or a deacon who wields some power.

As for the fifth level, in the army, there is a commander of 500 people, and those who are stronger can command a thousand people, and are often the chief general of a county.

Among the major sects, the fifth rank is the elders of each department in charge of power. It is the real core combat power of a sect, and it belongs to the background of suppressing luck and cannot be lightly moved.

As for the sixth-rank demigod, in the imperial court, it is the chief general of each province, or a general of a certain army in the imperial court's central army, who really holds the power.

In Zongmen, that is the suzerain of each sect, who belongs to the famous strong in the world today, and is an important factor for a sect to guarantee its own status, and belongs to the existence of nuclear deterrence.

Of course, all of these are divided by the forces that have demigods.

If a power doesn't even have a demigod, then in the eyes of the mainstream power, it's just an ant that can be destroyed easily.

As for demigods with first-level combat power of immortal gods, his division is another.

But generally speaking, at the realm of immortals and gods, basically they will not interfere with the affairs of the world.

After all, the two sides are not creatures of the same level, and they have different perspectives on things.

For the so-called fame and fortune in the mortal world, all kinds of things that the so-called strong people value and fight for have long been ignored.

Without desire, without seeking, without seeking, without action.

Therefore, the things in the world are nothing to those adults, even if it is a change of dynasty.

Unless something major happened, such as the destruction of the world, maybe they would still make a move, and they didn't care about the rest.
